chars.SANAA: BROTHER'S WIFE: a young Moroccan woman in her late twenties, long wavy dark brown hair loose, wine-red satin blouse, black wide-leg trousers, small gold hoop earrings
chars.NARRATOR: NARRATOR: a Moroccan man about 28, short black hair, neatly trimmed beard, olive-green bomber jacket over a plain white t-shirt, dark blue jeans
chars.MOM: MOM: a Moroccan woman about 55, cream djellaba with a beige headscarf, kind round face

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from a half-open doorway of a Moroccan apartment hallway: the brother's wife stands near a window holding her phone to her ear, calling someone, glancing over her shoulder secretively, head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible, calm background at the edges

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: A Moroccan salon with banquettes and patterned cushions: the mom smiles and offers tea, the brother's wife sits stiffly at the far end with arms crossed, cold and silent, looking away

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: The brother's wife walks quickly out of a Moroccan salon toward the hallway, avoiding the family, annoyed expression, seen from inside the salon

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Early morning on a Moroccan city street outside an apartment building: the narrator, leaving for work with a backpack, stops and looks at his ringing phone with surprise

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot of the narrator on the sidewalk holding the phone to his ear, eyebrows raised, puzzled and uneasy, Moroccan street blurred behind

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Inside a modest Moroccan apartment living room: the brother's wife sits on a sofa, leaning forward, complaining with expressive hands; the narrator sits on a chair opposite, listening awkwardly

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Same Moroccan living room, closer: the brother's wife with teary eyes tells her troubles, empty glasses and an ashtray on the low table behind her; the narrator, uncomfortable, glances at the door
